Telegram Stable Releases
Telegram for iOS has been updated 🎉🎊

🔄 New version:
12.6.2 (32737)

📆 Released (DD/MM/YYYY):
08/04/2026

🤖OS:
• iOS 13.0 and higher
• iPadOS 13.0 and higher
• visionOS 1.0 and higher

📄 Changelog:
AI text editor
• Correct, transform or translate text in the message bar using AI: 100% private and optional.
• Instantly rewrite your messages in different styles such as Formal, Short, Tribal, Corp, Zen, Biblical and Viking.
• Add relevant emojis to your text using the option "With Emoji".
• Translate your messages into another language with different styles.
• Check for grammatical errors in your text.

Live photo
• View Live Photos and Photos on the go.
• Send Live Photos in 3 playback styles: Live, Loop and Rebound.

More than 10 functions for surveys
• Attach media or positions to questions and options.
• Allow users to suggest new options in active surveys.
• Show who voted next to each option.
• Allow users to change their vote.
• Mix the options for each user.
• Set a specific duration for the survey.
• Hide the results until the end of the survey.
• View the results without voting as creator.
• Find past and active surveys in the Surveys tab on group and channel profiles.
• Receive notifications about new votes.
